<includeonly>{{#invoke:Erenshor/QuestData|panel}}</includeonly><noinclude>A quest's acquisition sources, dialog keywords, completion routes, requirements, rewards, faction effects, and repeat behavior, from [[Module:Erenshor/QuestData]] and the generated [[Module:Erenshor/Data/Quests]]. On a page that identifies one quest, use <code><nowiki>{{Quest data}}</nowiki></code>. Otherwise select its identity explicitly: <code><nowiki>{{Quest data|stablekey=quest:...}}</nowiki></code>. A page shared by several quests needs a separate explicit call for each quest.

The panel keeps each exported resource variant's required items and rewards together. Dialog prerequisites apply only to their own route. The export identifies some sources only by the quest as a whole, so the panel does not assign them to a variant by its name. Faction effects and quest-chain assignment occur on the first recorded completion, even when item turn-ins repeat.

Place this panel beside the article's existing quest information. Keep handwritten walkthroughs, strategy, and the legacy <code><nowiki>{{Quest}}</nowiki></code> template unchanged. Panel values come from game data. Report a missing or incorrect fact at [[Erenshor Wiki:Game Data]].</noinclude>
